claims.subject: application_fees
claims.statement: There is no fee to apply for the Riverbend Flood Recovery Grant or to have an application assessed.

claims.subject: payment_account
claims.statement: The department will never ask applicants to transfer money to any account.
claims.quote: The department will never ask applicants to transfer money to any account, and anyone who receives such a request should report it to the grant hotline.
